jobs.occupation: Network & Security Architect / Lead Engineer (freelance) M/W/X
jobs.description:
As a Network & Security Architect / Lead Engineer, you will join the Network & Security Team and play a key role in the design, evolution and implementation of the network and security landscape within a complex enterprise environment.

The assignment combines approximately 50% architecture and design with 50% hands-on engineering and troubleshooting.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Defining and developing Network & Security architectures, including HLD and LLD
• Establishing technical roadmaps and standards
• Leading and supporting datacenter projects and migrations
• Translating business and technical requirements into scalable solutions
• Reviewing implementations and ensuring technical quality
• Contributing directly to operational support and complex L3 troubleshooting
• Supporting critical incidents and problem analysis
• Coaching and guiding engineers within the team
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
This role requires a senior professional who can combine architectural thinking, technical leadership and hands-on expertise in a complex Network & Security environment.
 
We are looking for a Senior Network & Security professional, typically with 8+ years of experience, combining proven architecture and design expertise with a strong hands-on engineering background.

You have practical experience in complex enterprise and datacenter environments and are comfortable acting both as a technical architect and as a senior engineer involved in implementation and L3 troubleshooting.
Required expertise
• Strong experience in Network & Security architecture and design
• Practical Cisco ACI experience - mandatory
• Cisco Nexus
• Palo Alto NGFW and Prisma
• Firewalling, VPN, segmentation and Zero Trust
• VMware NSX
• Load balancing
• High-availability and mission-critical environments
• Multi-vendor enterprise environments
• Experience with complex migration and transformation projects
• Cisco certification (CCNP or higher) or equivalent expertise through experience
Experience with network automation, CI/CD and/or scripting is considered an advantage. PCNSE and/or Cisco ACI certifications are strong assets.

You combine an architectural mindset with a hands-on approach, have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and stakeholders. You are comfortable coaching engineers, sharing knowledge and acting as a technical reference within the team.

Fluent Dutch and English are required.
 Job Benefits
• Long-term assignment: 12 months+, renewable
• Hybrid working: approximately 4 days remote and 1 day per week onsite in Brussels
• Full-time assignment
• Work within a complex, enterprise-scale public-sector environment
• Combination of architecture/design and hands-on engineering
• Exposure to business-critical Network & Security infrastructure
• Opportunity to act as a technical reference and coach within the team
• Freelance / Time & Material contract

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes ¿ increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell ¿ scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation.
• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify ¿ our AI workflow platform ¿ to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes.
• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems ¿ understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other.
• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work.
• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience.
• You are proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work ¿ comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code.
• You have a genuine interest in AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process.
• You are comfortable integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end.
• You are at ease in a cloud environment (Google, AWS).
• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them.
• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts.
• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once.
• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation.
• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset 
• A unique professional positioning, obviously technology-focused, but truly cross-functional and business-oriented.
• An extremely pleasant working environment, based outside Brussels so you can avoid unnecessary traffic jams.
• Joining a team full of talented, motivated and passionate professionals. We are a human-sized company where team spirit and collaboration are the standard.
• Being involved in a fast-growing company offering real development opportunities.
• A company culture that values initiative, taking responsibility and commitment.
• An exciting and stimulating role in a fast-growing fintech.
• A competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.occupation: Medior/Senior ICT Project Manager Infrastructuurprojecten M/W/X
jobs.description:
As an ICT Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of strategic IT projects, with a strong focus on datacenter and infrastructure projects.

You will manage the planning, execution and follow-up of projects throughout their lifecycle and act as the main point of contact for project teams, management and external partners.

Your responsibilities include:

• Leading complex IT projects involving datacenter infrastructure, workplace environments, networks and system migrations.
• Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Program Manager or Service Manager.
• Coordinating the installation and equipment of physical datacenter environments.
• Managing network and system implementations, application migrations and handover to operational teams.
• Organising project meetings and facilitating alignment between all stakeholders.
• Leading and motivating project team members, with attention to team dynamics and coaching.
• Ensuring clear and effective communication throughout the project. 
We are looking for a Medior/Senior ICT Project Manager with solid experience in IT infrastructure projects within large and complex environments.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, with experience in infrastructure project management.
• Master's degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent through professional experience.
• Strong knowledge of both Waterfall and Agile project methodologies.
• Broad IT infrastructure experience, including datacenter migrations, workplace/endpoint management, virtualisation, network and system management.
• Demonstrated experience with physical datacenter installations, network and system implementations, application migrations, infrastructure roll-outs and handover to operational teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Professional knowledge of Dutch, French and English.
• Willingness to travel to client locations throughout Belgium. 
• Long-term assignment with the possibility of renewal.
• Full-time assignment of approximately 220 working days.
• Home Office is included in the working arrangement.
• Client assignments across Belgium, with location depending on the consultant's place of residence.
• Opportunity to work on complex and strategic IT infrastructure projects, including datacenter, network, system, workplace and migration projects.

An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. It will be a hands on role, with the consultant being tasked to work with the relevant teams to identify, structure and produce the documentation required to achieve their target goals.
What will you be doing?

• Interviewing stakeholders to capture undocumented processes

• Producing and maintaining documentation

• Collecting and organizing process level execution, vulnerability scan and process reports

Logistics

• Hands on profile

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP  experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:
	
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.	
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.	
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.	
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.	
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.	
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 
	
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 	
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .	
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.	
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities:	
• you take ownership	
• you guide and support others confidently	
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way	
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.	
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Our client is an international B2B organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services.
